title: Chain observations file
description: What the collector agent writes and the rules engine reads (ADR-0003). Source-neutral: rules never depend on which tool an item came from. The collector copies; rules classify and parse (ADR-0001).

collectedAt.description: When the collection ended. The only clock the rules read.

team.description: The team's own name, from chain.yml.

vocabulary.description: The team's words for display, from chain.yml. Keys are roles or 'group'.

sources.description: Every source chain.yml lists, read or not. A source not read is shown on the board, never guessed around.

id.description: Short id used as item id prefix, e.g. 'ado'.

connector.description: Which connector read it, e.g. 'ado-remote', 'ado-local', 'rovo', 'github'. Shown on the board; rules never read it.

partial.description: True when a limit stopped the read early.

reason.description: Why the source was not read or is partial, in plain words.

person.description: An account as the source shows it. Rules decide whether it is a person or an agent, using chain.yml patterns.

login.description: Account name or unique name in the source.

isBot.description: The source's own bot flag, when it has one; null when it does not say.

id.description: <source id>:<id in that source>, unique in the file.

role.description: Outcome is derived from merged changes, never collected.

source.description: Id of an entry in sources.

type.description: The team's word for this item, e.g. 'Epic', 'User Story', 'Pull request'.

sourceState.description: The state as the source names it, e.g. 'Closed', 'New'.

parent.description: Id of the item one role up, e.g. a story's Feature.

links.description: Links from this item to decisions. On a change: the plan, spec or intent items it delivers. Across tools: a page linked to a work item.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria, on the item that holds them (usually spec or plan).

id.description: AC-1 as written in the text, or AC-<position> assigned by the collector.

idSource.description: Whether the id was written in the source or assigned by position.

changedAt.description: Last time the criterion text changed, when the source keeps history.

change.description: Raw facts about a pull or merge request. No classification: rules derive authorship, divergences and findings.

repository.description: Repository name as the host shows it, e.g. 'example/fleet-portal'.

body.description: Description text, verbatim. Rules parse 'Divergences from plan' from it.

commits.description: Commits in the change; null when they could not be read.

trailers.description: Trailer lines of the commit message, verbatim, e.g. 'Co-Authored-By: ...'.

reviews.description: Reviews and comments, verbatim. Rules parse '[pass] Severity:' lines (REVIEW.md) from body.

state.description: Review verdict as the host records it; null for a plain comment.

body.description: Text, verbatim; empty string when the review has none.
